narr: A slow moving boundary combined with plenty of moisture and an unstable atmosphere led to instances of flooding and flash flooding overnight on the 14th into the early morning of the 15th.
ev: High standing water was blocking three lanes along Interstate 395 Northbound around VA 120.
Prince Street was closed due to high water over the roadway.
King Street was closed due to high water over the roadway.

The water level on Cameron Run at Alexandria - Eisenhower Avenue quickly rose above flood stage, cresting at 15.03 feet at 12:55 AM EST. Most of the lower Holmes Run Trail along Cameron Run was flooded.
The water level on Backlick Run in Alexandria rapidly rose above flood stage, cresting at 9.35 feet at 12:55 AM EST.
Old Richmond Highway was closed around Richmond Highway due to high water.
A vehicle was stuck on the ramp from Interstate 495 to Interstate 95 North due to high water.
A vehicle was stuck in high water along Arlington Boulevard eastbound around Route 7.
A building in the 600 Block of S Pickett Street was evacuated due to high water.
There was an extended road closure for Newington Road near Cinder Bed Road. Flash flooding of Long Branch displaced large sections of the top layer of asphalt.
